Use the Seismic Survey Tool with Paper in your inventory and it uses one sheet to write a Survey Record of that chunk: its dimension and coordinates, the deposit's kind, the oil left at the time, whether it's sweet or sour and whether it has a gas cap. Hover over it to read it.
# On a map
Right-click a filled map with a Survey Record (pick the record up and right-click it onto the map in your inventory) to mark the spot with a small oil derrick, sized by the deposit's kind. The map's tooltip lists the marked deposits by kind and place.
